Doctors were evaluating her for a possible heart-lung transplant after surgery was ruled out. She experienced a sudden decline in health and suffered cardiac arrest early Tuesday morning. Her father is seeking answers regarding the circumstances surrounding her death.

description: Japan has an impressive count of more than 2.6 million vending machines, providing a vast array of products for all kinds of consumers. Each machine is powered by advanced embedded computer systems that enhance the efficiency of product dispensing. Sophisticated sensors validate payments through coins or banknotes, while various mechanical methods ensure that products are delivered carefully. Additionally, dual-temperature machines serve both hot and cold beverages seamlessly.

description: More than 40 homeowners in Tennessee’s Sunset Bluff community have joined a $5 million lawsuit against developer Claude “Chip” Hayes III, accusing him of retaining control of their HOAs and mismanaging funds. Residents allege that nearly 80% of one HOA’s budget went to a lawn care company owned by Hayes, while several promised amenities remain unfinished.
title: More than 40 Tennessee tiny home owners seek $5m in HOA lawsuit

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Crown Princess Ingrid Alexandra, 22, has stepped into a historic new role as heir to Norway’s throne following King Haakon’s accession. As Haakon takes his constitutional oath, Ingrid Alexandra becomes the country’s first adult heir at the time of succession in modern history. If she becomes monarch, she could be Norway’s first reigning queen in over 600 years.
title: Meet Ingrid Alexandra, 22, who could become Norway's first queen in 600 years

author: SIDDHI DHARMADHIKARI
description: Maharashtra's chief minister has deferred enforcement action on loose edible oil sales for one year.  Traders must comply with the law after this mandatory transition period ends.  Joint committees will guide traditional traders in making necessary business practice changes.  The government will assist businesses with facilities and potential subsidies for compliance.  This decision balances public health concerns with the livelihoods of many traders.
title: Maharashtra puts FDA action against loose edible oil sales on hold for 1 year

description: East Zone secured a place in the Duleep Trophy final with a four-wicket victory over Central Zone. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's aggressive cameo provided crucial momentum during the chase for East Zone. Mohammed Shami and Mukesh Kumar delivered fiery spells to dismantle Central Zone's batting lineup. Mukesh was named Player of the Match for his outstanding seven-wicket haul in the semifinal.
title: Vice-captain Sooryavanshi shines as East beat Central to reach Duleep Trophy final

author: DILIP KUMAR
description: In light of recent floods from Nepal, the Bihar government has issued a warning about the presence of strange fish species in the Gandak river. Residents are advised to avoid consuming or selling these unidentified fish until their safety can be verified. Among these is the goonch catfish, locally called Gochita. Anyone who falls ill after eating these fish is urged to seek medical assistance promptly.

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Pakistan Cricket Board seeks explanation from its selection committee.  The board questioned the rationale behind including Mohammad Rizwan and Imam-ul-Haq.  This action follows the team's poor performance in the ongoing England Test series.  Several players and coaching staff have been released and replaced amid this overhaul.  Misbah-ul-Haq is reportedly set to resign from the selection committee.

A video showcasing his talent has gone viral, racking up millions of views across various social media sites. As a defender with a passion for football, Allen idolizes Lionel Messi and proudly supports Argentina.
title: Kerala Teen's Viral Resemblance: Allen James dubbed Kerala's Yamal; hopes for Yamal message

author: etimes.in
description: MasterChef India champion Pankaj Bhadouria has bravely opened up about her ongoing battle with breast cancer. Faced with serious health challenges this August, including painful infections and the emotional toll of hair loss, she has leaned on the love of family and friends. A recent outing with her loved ones symbolizes her resilience and progress, as Pankaj continues to embrace life with optimism and support despite the circumstances.
title: Pankaj Bhadouria shares ‘Cancer’ changed her; says 'Was weakened by infections'

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A nineteen-year-old man lost his life in a tragic act of courage while on his first subway journey. He leaped onto the tracks after his girlfriend stumbled, attempting to save her. Unfortunately, he came into contact with the electric third rail. Now in critical condition, his girlfriend is hospitalized, spurring urgent calls for better safety measures on subway platforms.
title: Boston teen, 19, dies after jumping onto train tracks to save girlfriend

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Father Henry J. Denis emerged from the horrors of Dachau concentration camp and the inhumane medical experiments conducted there. With a steadfast vow to create a shrine to Mary if he survived, he eventually settled in Nebraska, where he honored that promise. The Our Lady of Fatima Shrine, dedicated in August 1956, serves as a powerful symbol of hope and unwavering faith transcending time and geography.
title: Polish priest survived Nazi malaria experiments, then built Nebraska shrine

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Eighteen-year-old Emma Jarman recalls meeting Dolly Parton when she was just one day old at Rotherham Hospital in 2007. The singer had visited the UK to launch her Imagination Library literacy initiative, with Emma becoming its first UK recipient. Emma now reflects on their surreal encounter and Parton’s lasting impact on her life.
title: Emma Jarman met Dolly Parton as a newborn; 18 years later, she shares the story

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In Brighton, Michigan, a remarkable transformation has taken place with a once-neglected 1970s concrete dome home. Acquired in 2023 for $87,000, this property underwent a meticulous renovation, now boasting four bedrooms infused with modern luxury and eco-friendly features. Now on the market for $499,900, its unique design and energy-efficient qualities are captivating buyers in search of distinctive living spaces.
title: Crumbling 1979 Michigan dome bought for $87,000 now lists for $499,900

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Japan Cricket CEO Naoki Alex Miyaji clarified Asian Games accommodation arrangements for teams.  Participating teams are offered hotel stays and can arrange their own lodging.  Logistical constraints are affecting many sports, not just cricket at the event.  The Korogi Sports Park venue was built from scratch within a tight timeframe.  Organisers are confident cricket will make a strong impression at the Games.
title: Asian Games cricket row: Japan Cricket CEO says teams can make own arrangements

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Krunal Pandya remains optimistic about his potential return to international cricket after his absence in the Afghanistan T20I series. Jasprit Bumrah is set to rejoin the team, contingent on a positive fitness assessment concerning his knee injury. Additionally, several players, including Nitish Kumar Reddy, are included pending their fitness. Hardik Pandya, however, will not participate due to a leg issue affecting his comeback strategy.
title: ‘Hope is still alive’: Krunal reacts after missing out on India’s Afghan T20I squad

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Japan is constructing advanced missile-defence warships equipped with powerful radar systems. These new vessels will utilize the AN/SPY-7 radar for enhanced threat detection capabilities. The program aims to counter growing missile threats from North Korea and the wider region. These ships are scheduled to enter service in fiscal 2027 and 2028. Japan is enhancing its defense network to address evolving regional security challenges.
title: Missiles from anywhere? Japan’s new warship is built to spot them all

author: PRAJWAL HEGDE
description: Carlos Alcaraz returned to tennis after a long injury layoff. He played his first match in 139 days at the US Open. Alcaraz secured a convincing victory against Roman Safiullin in straight sets. The young Spaniard confirmed he was playing pain-free and felt great. He expressed happiness and a desire to enjoy every match.
title: ‘I felt great’: Alcaraz makes stunning US Open return after 139 days out with injury

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The WACO UPF-7 was used as a primary trainer from 1941, helping prepare pilots through the US government-backed Civilian Pilot Training Program during the World War II era. Retired in 1953, the aircraft was bought by a Florida owner who dismantled and packed it into boxes, carrying the parts through three moves over 50 years. Rediscovered in 2002, it was later restored by RARE Aircraft and returned to airworthy condition before being displayed at the Historic Flight Foundation.
title: WWII-era training plane spent 50 years in boxes before finally being restored

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Villa Aurora, a historic mansion in Pacific Palisades, has reopened after restoration work following the January 2025 Palisades Fire. The house was bought in 1943 for $9,000 by German Jewish writer Lion Feuchtwanger and his wife Marta, who had fled Nazi persecution. It later became a gathering place for artists and intellectuals and an international artist residency.
title: Villa Aurora, bought by Jewish refugees in 1943, reopens after Palisades fire

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: In August, Unified Payments Interface hit an all-time high for monthly transaction volumes, largely fueled by festive celebrations like Raksha Bandhan that encouraged peer-to-peer transfers. As transaction values approached previous peaks, the digital payment landscape continued to evolve, with UPI now being embraced in eleven countries worldwide. The potential for further growth is promising as innovative use cases, such as credit options within UPI, start to gain traction.
title: UPI gets festive boost: Digital payments hit a record 24.51 bn transactions in August

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Oracle layoffs 2026: The dreaded 6 am layoff email did not arrive on September 1, leaving employees across the US and India tracking Slack member counts and trading rumours of a September 15 date. Managers were asked to list affected staff before Oracle's second fiscal quarter began. After 21,000 job cuts, $55.7 billion in AI data centre spending and $1.8 billion in restructuring charges, Oracle staff are still waiting.
title: Oracle layoffs: The 6 am email didn't come, so employees are counting Slack members

author: SIDDHI DHARMADHIKARI
description: Mumbai Police arrested a top-ranking MPSC candidate in the drug inspector exam leak case.  This arrest brings the total number of accused individuals to seven now.  Police allege the candidate received the leaked paper and answered questions incorrectly.  The MPSC had previously cancelled the recruitment process due to the alleged breach.  A fresh examination will now be conducted to ensure fairness for all.
title: MPSC exam paper leak: ‘Top ranker’ arrested, intentionally gave 10 wrong answers

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: A robot vacuum's camera exposed a Taiwanese man's wife's alleged affair during a vacation. He used the secret footage to win emotional distress compensation in court. However, his wife sued him for illegally recording her without consent. The court found the husband violated his wife's privacy and sentenced him to jail. This unusual case resulted in both compensation and criminal punishment for the husband.
title: Man uses footage from a robot vacuum to prove his wife's affair, wins divorce case and lakhs in compensation; but ends in prison for …

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: Australian home prices dropped for a fifth month in August. Sydney and Melbourne saw significant declines, now seven percent below peaks. Higher borrowing costs and inflation are squeezing buyer demand across the nation. Analysts predict further price falls, potentially reaching ten percent from their highest points. This housing slowdown impacts economic growth and consumer spending significantly.
title: Australian home prices extend decline as inflation, rate fears weigh

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Liam McCracken faces a major fight on Dana White’s Contender Series.  Three years ago, he survived a severe bus accident which nearly ended his career.  Doctors feared his injuries would prevent him from fighting professionally again.  Remarkably, McCracken recovered and returned to fighting after nearly two years.  He now seeks a UFC contract to provide for his family.
title: Dragged 60ft under a bus, now fighting for UFC contract: How did Liam McCracken survive?

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Kara Maxine Bieber’s recent pre-fall style post offers a warm glimpse into her life beyond Shane Bieber’s baseball career. As she prepares to welcome her second child, her relaxed flannel look reflects a simple, confident approach to fashion. With son Kav soon becoming a big brother, Kara is embracing a meaningful family chapter while still finding joy in the everyday moments that make this season feel special.

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Former Pakistan captain Shahid Afridi strongly criticised the PCB's decision.  Seven players and coaches were removed after significant losses to England.  This overhaul included five uncapped players for the final Test match.  Misbah-ul-Haq has also reportedly resigned from the selection committee.  The team faces a challenging task to avoid a series whitewash.

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: OpenAI has pushed back against Apple's claims of trade secret theft in a recent federal court document. OpenAI asserts that internal strife at Apple is to blame for the current legal confrontation, while Apple alleges that its former staff members improperly extracted proprietary data upon leaving for OpenAI. OpenAI maintains that employees are entitled to seek new professional ventures, spotlighting a legal dispute that traces back to their earlier collaboration.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Jasmyn Blackburn, a kindergarten teacher, uses colorful and sparkly clothing to inspire her young students.  She believes in 'dopamine dressing,' which means wearing clothes that bring happiness.  Her unique style has gained a significant following on social media platforms.  Blackburn's wardrobe features many school-themed items, reflecting her passion for teaching.  She encourages others to find joy in their personal style and express themselves.
title: Meet Jasmyn Blackburn, the kindergarten teacher making dopamine dressing a hit

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The historic North Park Observation Tower in Pittsburgh is poised to reopen its doors after being closed for years. A comprehensive restoration effort is underway, focusing on the beloved 1937 building and its staircase, while also enhancing the surrounding park area with fresh landscaping and improved accessibility. Funded by a mix of public and private investments, the landmark is anticipated to welcome guests once more by 2027.
title: Closed for decades, Pittsburgh's 102-foot lookout is being restored for $3m

author: SHALABH
description: A Ganga Expressway ramp in Unnao experienced a cave-in after heavy rainfall on Tuesday. Workers temporarily covered the damaged section to divert gushing rainwater effectively. The concessionaire and contractor swiftly repaired the affected portion within two and a half hours. Continuous rain also caused waterlogging at the nearby toll plaza on the expressway. Long-term measures are planned to prevent future waterlogging issues at the toll booths.
title: Heavy rain causes cave-in on Ganga Expressway ramp, carpet used as quick fix

author: PRACHI KUMAWAT
description: The Supreme Court's recent verdict has annulled all FIRs filed against students engaged in protests related to NEET across the country. This notable decision serves justice to the protesting individuals and their grieving families. Moreover, it mandates the government to offer compensation to the relatives of those who tragically took their own lives. CJP's Abhijeet Dipke heralded this ruling as essential justice for all participants.
title: NEET protest FIRs quashed: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke calls SC move ‘absolute justice’

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: During a recent dialogue, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian expressed gratitude towards Vladimir Putin for Russia's supportive position. He emphasized the need for Iran and Russia to jointly counter the unilateral actions of the United States. Pezeshkian also condemned the U.S. for its sanctions and breaches of international law. Putin, in response, endorsed the memorandum aimed at fostering cooperation between Iran and Russia amidst escalating tensions with the U.S.
title: 'We can resist US unilateralism': Iran president tells Putin on sidelines of SCO summit

title: $4 million diamond necklace stolen in daylight heist at Vienna museum

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Pakistan Cricket Board's recent squad and coaching changes have drawn significant criticism.  Multan Sultans CEO Gohar Shah voiced concerns over player professionalism and team intensity.  He also highlighted issues within the wider cricket ecosystem, including media and former players.  Shah pointed to bureaucratic hurdles and a lack of incentive for PCB stakeholders.  His assessment offered a candid view on the state of Pakistan cricket.
title: ‘May land me in hot water’: Multan Sultans CEO delivers explosive take on Pak cricket

author: JAIRAJ SINGH
description: He has alleged he was covertly filmed with Ray-Ban Meta glasses and turned into subject of viral content. His legal notice now raises a larger question: Can Meta be held responsible for designing eyewear that allows unsuspecting bystanders to be recorded?

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Researchers have identified a piezoelectric effect in ultrathin diamond membranes.  This effect, previously unseen in bulk diamond, appears in thin polycrystalline sheets.  Grain boundaries within these membranes are responsible for generating electrical responses when deformed.  The strongest piezoelectric response was observed in membranes approximately five micrometres thick.  This discovery opens doors for new applications in energy harvesting and smart electronics.
title: Bending ultrathin diamond sheets generates electricity, study finds

author: SIDHHARRTH S KUMAAR
description: On September 2, 2026, Venus will transit into Libra, bringing about a transformation in relational dynamics. Individuals with Libra traits can anticipate a boost in self-assurance and richer social engagements. For Geminis, expect sparked creativity and enchanting romantic dialogues. Virgos will turn their attention to financial matters after a period of discontent. Meanwhile, Capricorns may find new professional ventures, while Aquarians may enjoy fortuitous occurrences.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Lance and Lisa Wheeler's Colorado ranch has transformed into a sanctuary for grassland birds, boasting a remarkable doubling in species detection since 2019. Their innovative farming methods, coupled with adaptive grazing strategies, promote rich habitats that support diverse wildlife. As evidenced by a 26% increase on the ranch's Bird-Friendliness Index, this holistic approach successfully merges livestock management with conservation efforts.
title: Bird species rose from 29 to 37 after Colorado couple restored family ranch

author: PRACHI KUMAWAT
description: Union minister Chirag Paswan received a death threat through postal mail on Tuesday.  The letter warned of his imminent killing by "hardcore Terrorists" and prompted immediate action.  His office has formally communicated this serious threat to the Union home secretary.  The contents and delivery circumstances will undergo a thorough security assessment.  Further details regarding the threat and security measures remain unavailable.
title: Union minister Chirag Paswan gets death threat; seeks protection

author: NIRMALYA DUTTA
description: Now, Messi and Djokovic do have a lot in common. Both came from impoverished backgrounds and became the greatest ever to play their respective sports. Both were even born in the same year, just 33 days apart. Both chased dreams that seemed unattainable, with families who bet their futures on their children’s success. Both had similarly close paternal relationships and left home early to train. In their early days, both even faced similar physical limitations. Messi needed growth hormones; Djokovic switched his diet and conditioning to produce extraordinary endurance hitherto unseen in tennis.
title: Should Novak Djokovic take a leaf from Lionel Messi and retire?

author: TNN
description: A bike mechanic was arrested for raping and strangling a nurse in Pahadishareef.  He allegedly watched the woman for a month before entering her room through a window.  The accused returned to his garage and slept after committing the crime.  Mobile data and forensic evidence helped investigators crack the difficult case.  Police are checking the accused's criminal record in Bihar.
title: 'He killed her, then went back to sleep': Calm of Hyderabad nurse's killer baffles cops

title: Centre halves sugar stock limit for dealers to curb hoarding, price rise

author: KANCHAN YADAV
description: UP Congress president Ajay Rai filed a defamation case against Yogi Adityanath. Rai alleging that the CM's remarks about a fish feast hurt his religious sentiments. The controversy began after a video of fish preparation at a Congress event surfaced. Adityanath had accused Rai of duplicity for attending the event. Rai denied eating fish and challenged the chief minister to provide proof.
title: Fish video row: Ajay Rai files defamation case against CM Yogi for 'hurting faith'

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: The Indian cricket team has officially unveiled their 15-member squad for the T20I series against Afghanistan, with Shreyas Iyer as captain and Tilak Varma as vice-captain. The pace attack is bolstered by the return of Jasprit Bumrah, alongside Arshdeep Singh and Harshit Rana. Notable batsmen include Sanju Samson and Ishan Kishan, although some players still await fitness clearance prior to the series start.
title: Bumrah, Samson back; Pandya misses out as India announce squad for Afghanistan T20Is

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Global tech giant Microsoft has put around 500 employees in India on performance improvement plans (PIPs), while Oracle is preparing to cut roughly 3,000 jobs in the country as technology companies reorganise their workforces and redirect spending towards newer areas.
title: India’s tech jobs face another jolt: Oracle to cut 3,000, Microsoft puts 500 on PIPs

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Tech investor Gavin Baker has changed his stance on data centers, now recognizing the valid concerns that were present around eighteen months ago. However, with well-structured projects resolving many of these issues, data centers are now contributing positively to local economies, especially benefiting blue-collar workers in small towns. He suggests that criticism towards data centers may no longer be relevant in light of these advancements.
title: ‘I regret the tone’: Top tech investor clarifies data center remarks

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: In August, India's manufacturing sector experienced its most significant slowdown in five years, with production and new orders seeing a decline. This downturn marked the lowest activity level since August 2021, causing a contraction in employment for the first time in two and a half years. Although there was a slight increase in purchasing activity, overall overseas demand weakened, and while business confidence grew, it remained below historical averages.
title: India’s PMI slips to 52.8 as factory growth loses steam, hits five-year low

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: Both models get revised styling, including split LED headlights, slimmer and taller kidney grilles with illuminated surrounds and larger bumper air intakes. Changes along the side include redesigned side skirts and alloy wheels, while the rear receives wraparound LED tail-lights, a new tailgate and revised bumper.
title: Upcoming cars in September 2026: Kia Sorento, BMW 7 Series & more

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Seventeen-year-old Thea Frodin is making her U.S. Open singles debut against No. 2-ranked Elena Rybakina after earning a wild card. Before stepping onto the tennis court in New York, Frodin appeared in “King Richard” as Serena Williams’ body double. She says tennis remains her priority, but she would love to balance her career with acting if Hollywood calls again.
title: From ‘King Richard’ to US Open: Thea Frodin played Serena’s body double 5 years ago

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: The Army has started rebuilding its Arjun tanks after a significant delay. Two Mk-1 tanks will receive upgrades and serve as a pilot program. This overhaul aims to improve the remaining 124 tanks in the fleet. The Arjun Mk-1A program faces delivery delays due to engine supply issues. India's defense production faces persistent challenges despite self-reliance efforts.
title: Six years overdue, Army begins first full overhaul of indigenous Arjun tanks

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: In the first quarter, India showcased impressive economic resilience with a remarkable 7.8% GDP growth. The surge was notably driven by a surge in domestic demand and the services sector. Additionally, investment activity picked up pace, enhancing the overall economic landscape. This achievement stands out amid global geopolitical tensions and market fluctuations, reinforcing India's status as the fastest-growing major economy in the world.
title: India's GDP grows 7.8% in Q1: Factors powering the economy despite global turmoil

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: India and Russia are discussing major defense deals for missile systems.  The S-500 missile defense system and Su-57 stealth fighter are key topics.  These discussions aim to deepen military ties between the two nations.  India faces an aircraft shortfall and regional air power challenges.  Broader defense cooperation and potential upgrades were also on the agenda.
title: S-500 and Su-57 on the table: What India could gain from its next big Russia defence deals

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A woman from South Jersey has taken a stand against the government's plan to acquire her land, which is intended for a new housing development in Middle Township. She asserts that the seizure does not serve public interest. Ongoing legal proceedings and negotiations haven't resolved the matter, underscoring the potential consequences of eminent domain on marginalized communities.
title: New Jersey woman paid $40,000 for land; town now wants it for 340 homes

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Tim Sweeney has a message for Apple's new chief executive. Hours after John Ternus took over from Tim Cook on September 1, the Epic Games founder posted that Apple is entering a new age, urging it to grow by building better hardware and software rather than extracting more from developers. Epic has been fighting Apple in court since 2020, and the battle is not over.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: An Arkansas bridge demolition failed unexpectedly on October 11, 2016. Explosives weakened the structure, but it did not collapse as planned. Crews then used barges and cables to bring down the aged structure. A new bridge was constructed and opened to traffic in March 2017. The unusual demolition became a memorable part of the bridge's history.

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Researchers created an artificial reef from coal-fired power station waste in Poole Bay. Marine life began colonizing the structure almost immediately after its deployment. Adult lobsters and edible crabs reached the reef within three weeks of its placement. The structure attracted schools of pouting and supported reproduction for several species. This experiment showed industrial waste could become a productive marine habitat.
title: UK turned 50 tonnes of coal waste into reef; lobsters arrived within 3 weeks

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

author: TANUJ LAKHINA
description: Behind the BWF World Championship interviews were interpreters carrying the weight of accuracy. At the recently concluded tournament in New Delhi, young language experts in Mandarin, Japanese and Korean navigated high-pressure media interactions, preparing with archival footage and AI tools to ensure players' words crossed cultural and linguistic barriers without losing their meaning.
title: From watching anime to translating shuttlers: Young interpreters' untold story

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: Penguin Random House India has decided to pause the publication of Sonia Gandhi's memoir, citing an editorial disagreement. The publisher clarifies that this choice was not influenced by outside pressure but rather emerged from routine editorial evaluations. During the review process, some proposed changes were accepted while others were not. In the end, an unresolved issue led to the book's non-release in India, which the author's team acknowledged.
title: 'A particular issue': Penguin India on impasse over Sonia Gandhi memoir

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Connor McDavid's wife Lauren Kyle has shared a rareupdate about the star player ahead of the new season as he stays out of the spotlight.
title: Connor McDavid’s wife Lauren Kyle hints at major life change

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Travis Kelce is gearing up for his 14th season on the field but it seems his investment in Six Flags has landed in major trouble.
title: Travis Kelce’s multimillion dollar investment faces trouble before new season

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Lionel Messi’s international retirement has prompted tributes across Argentina, including an emotional message from President Javier Milei. After 207 appearances and 125 goals, Messi leaves the national team following a 21-year career featuring a World Cup and two Copa América titles. The 39-year-old will continue playing for Inter Miami, but his Argentina chapter is now over.
title: Argentina president Milei joins tributes to Messi, calls him an ‘impossible man’

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg and his spouse Priscilla Chan have acquired the majestic Strancally Castle in County Waterford, Ireland. Spanning around 440 acres, the estate boasts a rich history dating back to 1830. The couple intends to use this beautifully restored property as a retreat during their visits, reinforcing Meta's strong ties to Ireland, where the company has its international headquarters.
title: Mark Zuckerberg buys 440-acre Irish castle estate; spokesperson says family is ‘excited’

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
title: US army secretary Dan Driscoll steps down after 18 months in service

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Duane Davis was convicted of orchestrating Tupac Shakur's 1996 murder.  The jury reached its verdict after nearly thirty years since the shooting occurred.  Prosecutors presented multiple statements where Davis admitted responsibility for the fatal incident.  His defense argued he was lying, but no witness corroborated this claim.  Davis now faces a potential life sentence for his role in the crime.
title: Tupac Shakur death case: Duane 'Keffe D' Davis convicted of first-degree murder

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: In a bold move, President Trump has rebranded Lake Ontario as Lake America during ongoing trade conflicts. This shift is now reflected on Google Maps for American users, while international observers will encounter alternative names. Apple's mapping services have also adopted this change, prompting a response from the Canadian Prime Minister, who emphasized the historical significance of the original designation.
title: Google renames Lake Ontario ‘Lake America’ in US; what others will see

author: ANUJA JAISWAL
title: Power failure hits Jaipur centres again, AIIMS CRE exam cancelled

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Australia have dropped Marnus Labuschagne from their ODI squad for tours of Zimbabwe and South Africa after a poor run of form. His Test future is also uncertain. Travis Head and Mitchell Marsh return, while Joel Davies earns his first ODI call-up. Spencer Johnson and Billy Stanlake strengthen the pace attack as Australia prepares for the 2027 World Cup.
title: Australia lose patience as star batter left out of ODI squad

author: SAUMYAJIT BASU
title: GOATbye: Leo blows whistle on Messimerising international career

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: University of Cape Town researchers are transforming heavily polluted water from South Africa’s Stiebeuel River into irrigation water using stones, sand and heat-treated wood. The off-grid Water Hub treats around 36,000 litres daily and removes about 99% of toxins. The project is helping Langrug residents grow food while offering a potential climate-resilience model.
title: Cape Town project turns polluted river water into 36,000L of clean irrigation daily

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: 'Keep my wife's name the hell out of your mouth': JD Vance on remarks about Usha

author: TNN & Agencies
description: A five-member bench is set to examine the plea from Indiabulls Housing Finance against Subhash Chandra. This review follows the NCLAT's validation of a Rs 6.5 crore payment order. Solicitor General Tushar Mehta contends that this ruling undermines the principles of the Insolvency & Bankruptcy Code. The NCLT delivered a divided opinion regarding Chandra's repayment strategy.
title: 5-member NCLT bench to hear Indiabulls plea against Chandra

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Dedicated arborists are engaged in the meticulous restoration of a 300-year-old live oak tree located near the historic Eutaw Springs battlefield in South Carolina. The project involves the careful removal of outdated metal supports to enhance the tree’s longevity, while modern support systems and improved soil conditions are being implemented, all in preparation for the upcoming 250th anniversary of the United States.
title: 245-year-old live oak from Revolutionary War battle freed from chains

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups saw earnings drop significantly on its first Monday. The film collected Rs 7.45 crore net in India on its sixth day. This collection brings the movie's India net total to Rs 221.55 crore. Worldwide gross earnings for the film have now reached Rs 304.05 crore. The Kannada version recorded the strongest overall occupancy among major language releases.
title: Toxic Box Office Day 6: Yash film drops 67%, crosses Rs 304 cr worldwide

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
title: Times Square stabbing: 1 killed, 1 critically injured; suspect shot dead by NYPD

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A climber suffered serious injuries after falling 15 to 20 feet while tackling a challenging route near Shortoff Mountain in North Carolina. During the rescue, a Burke Rescue volunteer ran 1.5 miles through Linville Gorge, climbing 1,000 feet in 31 minutes while carrying critical whole blood to help stabilise the injured climber.
title: Rescuer runs 1.5 miles with blood to save climber after 20-foot fall

author: TNN
description: A Hyderabad resident protested severe road damage by sitting in a large pothole. This unusual demonstration brought traffic to a standstill on a busy city road. The protest highlighted public frustration over potholes which have multiplied after recent rains. Civic authorities stated that patchwork had been done multiple times on the damaged stretch. Road levelling work is underway, and repairs will be completed soon.
title: Watch: Hyderabad man sits in pothole to protest crumbling Old City roads
